title: AphasiaBD: A Bengali Speech Dataset for Broca's and Global Aphasia
why_promising: Primary Bengali clinical speech from 38 post-stroke aphasia patients; 335 public audio clips across conversation, repetition, question-answering, and reading; recordings were manually segmented at sentence level and the deposit names dedicated annotators.
open_question: Current record establishes manual utterance segmentation but not phone-level manual intervals or token-level acoustic measurements. Inspect ZIP contents before core admission and determine whether phonemic-error labels or finer annotations are distributed and isolable.
